column1: # *** ROSARIO CATEDRAL - CONFIRMACIONES 1883-1904, READ TO THE END. *** DGS 004531018.
# Finished 14 September 2026, the same day as Santa Rosa de Lima. *** Both of Rosario's confirmation
# registers covering Pablo Armando's childhood are now complete, and he is in neither. ***
*** THE VOLUME IS FINISHED - and it ends at image 145, not 148 ***
column2: DGS 004531018 (zero-padded; 4531018 alone returns a blank Film # page). *** Images 81 to 145 read on 14 September 2026, every transcript non-empty, 1,872 to 5,812 characters, *** searched for seven spellings. These are TABULAR pages - Numero / Fecha / Confirmante / Edad - much denser than prose acts. *** Images 5-80 of the same volume were read earlier in the month. *** *** SO THE WHOLE OF 'Catedral Nuestra Senora del Rosario. Confirmation Records 1883-1904' HAS NOW BEEN READ, END TO END, AND HOLDS NO LERENA. ***
column3: PRIMARY - full-text transcripts read here, page by page
column4: *** Together with Santa Rosa de Lima, finished the same day, BOTH Rosario confirmation registers covering Pablo Armando's childhood are now read to the end, and he is in neither. *** He was born 22 February 1882; this volume runs to 1904 and the other to 1897. *** The confirmation route is exhausted for the two parishes that had registers early enough to hold him. ***

column1: *** THE TASK WAS DEFINED WRONG, AND THE FILM SAYS SO ***
column2: This archive's errand said 'images 81-148'. *** Image 145 is the last page of the volume: *** it carries an ark in its page title (3:1:9Q97-Y3S1-TXL). *** Images 146, 147 and 148 carry NO ark - their title is just 'Registros parroquiales, - Film # 004531018' - *** and their transcripts are empty because they are not part of this volume at all. *** The film holds 421 images, not 148, and contains SEVERAL volumes. ***
column4: *** Three empty transcripts that looked exactly like the throttle were not the throttle. *** Earlier the same day, images 86-89 and 98-99 came back empty and DID read clean after a pause. *** The distinguishing sign is the page TITLE: a throttled page still resolves to the volume name; an image outside the volume resolves to the bare film name and has no ark. *** *** Without that check these three would have been logged as 'not read' forever, and the volume would never have been called finished. ***

column1: *** AND THE ONE HIT IS A GIRL'S FORENAME ***
column2: Image 143 returned *** SERENA *** - the S-for-L variant this family carries six times over, so it had to be answered. Read in place, it sits in a column of given names: "Maria Eulalia / Angel Milanes / Julio / Elisa / *** Serena *** / Vitora / Jose / Cayetano / Tomas / Pedro / Josefa..."
column4: *** It is the Italian and Spanish girl's name SERENA, not the surname. *** The page is a tabular confirmation list and the column is forenames. *** Recorded rather than dropped, because a bare hit-count on this film would show 'one Serena' and a future reader would have to open it again to find out it was nothing. ***

column1: *** WHAT ELSE IS ON THE FILM, AND WHY IT IS NOT BEING READ ***
column2: Image 200 opens as *** 'Catedral Nuestra Senora del Rosario. Confirmation Records 1904-1918' *** - the next confirmation volume, under a different waypoint on the same film.
column4: *** Pablo Armando would be 22 to 36 across it, and he was in South Africa for most of that span. *** Confirmation at that age is possible but rare, and this archive already has him abroad. *** Named here so that 'the film has 421 images' does not read as 276 unexamined pages: they are examined enough to be ruled out of scope, which is a different thing from unread. ***
